entities.name: Ivan Mikhailovich Martynov

entities.summary: Ivan Mikhailovich Martinov SJ, was a Russian Jesuit priest. After his conversion to Catholicism and consequent exile, he placed his vast knowledge of Slavic culture at the service of a better understanding between the Russian Orthodox and Catholic Churches.
